questions.q: True or false? The restart taker should run forward before the back three is rebuilt.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. The taker rebuilds the back three first, then joins the attack later.
choiceExplanations: Two blue strikers stay high, so running forward leaves two backs against two with no cover.
Right, it's false. The taker rebuilds the back three first, then joins the attack later.

questions.q: The right midfielder gets the ball back. What should the central midfielder do next?
options: Stay in the middle and watch
Move behind to cover the right side
questions.explain: Right. The central midfielder moves behind the ball to replace the covering job.
choiceExplanations: Running forward leaves nobody behind the ball if we lose it on the right.
Standing still gives no cover and no new angle for the right midfielder.
Right. The central midfielder moves behind the ball to replace the covering job.

questions.q: Now our left back took the restart. Tap where the left back should go next.
options: Run forward past the left midfielder
questions.explain: Yes. Rejoining the back line rebuilds three backs against their two strikers, just like on the right.
choiceExplanations: Two blue strikers stay high, so running forward leaves our back line one short.
Yes. Rejoining the back line rebuilds three backs against their two strikers, just like on the right.
The middle is not the missing job. The back line still has only two players.
